answer: First, each agent commits its public key to one probe endpoint and publishes a log of 200 peer bandwidth tests, each sustaining 500 Mbps for 60 seconds under 40ms latency. One honest agent runs 1 endpoint for a 200 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 endpoints, 10 logs, and 10 witness slots, so costs scale 10X. Verifiers replay the orchard of test routes, check the umber latency band for shared-link signatures, and reject any nebula burst matching a clone; mismatched logs slash the bond and freeze repeat offenders.
